name: Hauser's Superior View Farm
description: Hauser's Superior View Farm is a working apple orchard in Bayfield, WI. It grows Blueberries, Apples, Pears, Cherries, and Flowers, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
